description: This file defines a PHP controller class for handling coupon-related API requests in an OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class processes input data, validates the coupon, customer, and cart, and returns success or error responses accordingly.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Controller class for coupon API handling within the OpenCart platform.
